pattern_name: Per-Call EOB Check vs Inlined Bitstream Refill
variant_desc: 5-bit symbol bitstream decoder, 1M symbols, per-call vs inlined refill
source_citation: https://fgiesen.wordpress.com/2016/01/02/end-of-buffer-checks-in-decompressors/ — Fabian Giesen 2016 on end-of-buffer check restructuring. Production in zstd, Oodle, brotli.
novelty_rationale: Tests whether the LLM knows to (a) move the EOB check out of the hot loop via a padded temp buffer, (b) replace per-call get_bits() abstraction with inline shifts. CSE cannot hoist the per-call check because cursor changes every call. The fix requires API restructuring (peek-vs-consume separation) that no compiler pass synthesizes.
